status: Post-review correctness repair and disclosed protocol deviation, after the one optional policy-improvement budget was exhausted; not unchanged preregistration.
required_semantics: A FIFO queue contains common setup, forced or selective retention/Gym preparation, and optional productization; each task records committed, consumed and remaining seconds and completion state.

Cash charges occur exactly once at commitment. Failed and unfinished work retains its charges; opportunity cost is represented by consumed capacity and resulting production displacement, without a second cash charge.
After checkpoint commitments and any existing growth purchase, preparation consumes actual daily gross capacity before production. Excess preparation carries forward without truncation or borrowing.

The audit is unavailable until setup completes. Active capability mode remains Beta until its entire retention/Gym task completes. Prototype success is revealed and its offering activated only on completion; an unfinished prototype has no known outcome.

The already-committed base audit may enter prospective productization valuation, as in the previous policy, but not current delivery availability. Pending prototype outcomes never enter the valuation catalogue.

Committed capability target is separate from active mode and prevents repeat commitments. Existing price calculations, demand draws, investment formulas and calendar upkeep commitments are preserved; upkeep on an unfinished committed target is an assumption, not evidence of readiness.

Before reading a prospective lead's hidden fields, acquire it only if at least one currently ready offering can fit remaining capacity. Acquired-lead counts alone update the demand-rate estimate; the effects of this censoring on growth are reported, not retuned.

Reserved job capacity is not reclaimed. Any observed numerical workload exceeding its declared kernel reservation fails closed rather than clipping an overrun or inventing debt/cancellation semantics.
Check daily and cumulative gross capacity = preparation consumed + job reservations + unused capacity, and backlog conservation = prior backlog + new commitments - preparation consumed.

Report horizon unfinished tasks/seconds, active versus committed mode, task completion, and a separate weighted-output-per-total-available-capacity-hour diagnostic; retain the historical job-processing ratio under its existing name.

Export capacity_paths.json with mean daily readiness, active/committed mode fractions, preparation backlog/consumption, job reservation and unused capacity for all six policies in capacity_pressure; preserve the existing base-path schema.
